name: Poliquin Step-Up
instructions: Put a slant board or a small weight plate on a low step so that its high end is at the back. Stand side-on on it with your working foot, heel higher than toes.
Let your other leg hang off the side of the step with the ankle pulled up.
Bend your working knee and let it travel forward over your toes as you lower your free heel to the floor.
Touch the floor lightly with the free heel. Do not put weight on it.
Straighten your working knee to come back up to the start. Do all the repetitions, then change sides.
